Two Pi warm replacements failed BINDING_NOT_AUTHORIZED during M1 live UI campaign, without birth records; later refill succeeded automatically. Exact refusal frontier absent from receipts; not attributed to L1 without evidence.

M2e live HTTP startup waited about 2m20s for initial Pi build-identity inventory scan; stack dump confirms dependency through EmbeddedInventoryOwner.start. Separate owner claim from background initial discovery with retry and retained shutdown. M3c global rollout and second normal boot served HTTP before per-agent recovery; see m3c-ui-recovery.md.

M2e real Codex request delivered and acknowledged, but provider returned usageLimitExceeded. Pi and Claude succeeded. Full three-provider UI success cannot be claimed; no quota bypass or repeated requests.

Local contact is now refreshed only by current owner heartbeat; stale or replaced owner cannot preserve Ready. 46 source/installed cases passed (M3d), global rollout pending. Accessible ACK discrepancy did not recur in M3c; no ACK fix claimed.

M2e Pi recurrence diagnosed: three claimed openings without births had no original-owner containment path after native factory failure. Shared Core fix passed installed process tests. Joint M3c rollout automatically contained all three retained launches; Pi and Claude replied via Meta-harness. M3c then shut down gracefully in 6.46s and recovered all agents after restart, with a fresh Pi response. Initial CONFIG_ERROR subtype remains unproven. See m3c-ui-recovery.md.

M3c generation 68 process absent when UI was revisited, last access log 20:58:19 UTC, no recorded normal shutdown/traceback or matching Application Error event. Cause/initiator unproven. Logs preserved; generation 69 recovered all agents and Pi answered. Supervisor/host-lifetime qualification must distinguish host termination from runtime faults.

Generation 69: RECOVERY_PUBLICATION_DELAYED diagnostic write timed out and escalated to host containment, stranding all local agents. M3f makes transient diagnostic persistence best-effort without changing receipt/authority durability. Origin of initial writer delay unproven. Global generation 70 recovered all agents; Graph presence confirmed. Pi and Claude replied through the real Meta-harness with 1/1 ACK on generation 70. M4d2 narrows diagnostic fallback to RECOVERY_PUBLICATION_DELAYED only; other durable recovery evidence stays required.

Contained embedded owner replacement waits for retained cleanup and claims the exact predecessor generation. Source, installed and real Pi UI qualification passed; same HTTP process recovered and served new work without replay. Caller interruption notice is covered by L18. Production generation 73 still runs M3i; rollout pending. See m3k-owner-replacement.md and m3k-real-ui.md.

First global M4d1 migration: Pi stayed RECOVERING until 03:03:20.844Z after host ready at 02:54:18Z. Closed-history retirement still precedes agent READY; certificates progressed 3/18/55 then readiness after first page. Move verified historical maintenance outside admission while retaining exact release/publication proofs; qualify with real retained history. CPU was saturated in one observation, not an attribution of the complete delay. M4d2 separates historical checkpoints from READY and live response publication; 50 installed tests passed. Real retained-history latency qualification remains pending. Deployed in generation 71; Pi reached READY in about 8s, but this boot reused earlier checkpoints and is not a controlled first-backfill comparison.

Agents initially displayed old RECOVERING until Refresh Agents while all three backend recovery rows were READY; subsequent view mount showed ONLINE. Existing poll pauses when document.hidden; cause not yet attributed and no frontend fix claimed. Follow-up 06:44–06:46 UTC 2026-10-17: generation 72 CONTROL_READY; Pi/Claude/Codex READY and Online in both existing Chrome tabs without reload/restart, four Pi WARM slots, renewed leases. Cause remains unproven. Follow-up 07:30–07:32 UTC again READY/Online with renewed leases and Pi 4 WARM; stale last-contact display observed but cause not proven. One delayed Pi publication did not change durable readiness. Follow-up 07:52 UTC: generation 73 CONTROL_READY, all three READY/Online, Pi four WARM and no backoff. Both existing tabs Online without reload; one retained 07:32 last-contact while the other showed current heartbeat. Cause of the original Recovering report remains unproven. See m3i-ui-rollout.md. Follow-up 08:42-08:43 UTC: generation 73 CONTROL_READY, three agents READY/Online in both existing tabs without reload, four Pi WARM and no pending deliveries. No newer durable recovery event after initial readiness at 07:46 UTC; cause remains unproven. Follow-up 09:25-09:27 UTC: user again reported all Recovering. Read-only inspection found generation 73 CONTROL_READY with fresh heartbeat, Pi/Claude/Codex READY, four Pi WARM slots and no pending deliveries. Both existing 8202 Chrome tabs displayed Online without reload or restart; one had an older last-contact observation. AgentsView polling skips hidden documents and has no visibility-change refresh, but this does not establish the cause of the reported Recovering state. Requested the affected screen/address; finding remains open. Follow-up 09:58-09:59 UTC: same production PID 32480 and generation 73, CONTROL_READY with fresh heartbeat; all three local agents READY since 07:46 UTC, Pi four WARM and no pending deliveries. Both existing browser tabs displayed Local Online without refresh, reload or restart. One tab retained an older last-contact observation (09:37 UTC). No causal attribution or deployed fix claimed. Follow-up 10:55-10:58 UTC: same PID 32480 and generation 73, fresh CONTROL_READY; both existing Agents tabs show the three local agents Online without refresh/restart. Second tab still displays 09:59 last-contact. Unlike previous observations, Pi has four post-startup recoveries, with version_probe_timeout logged before containment and automatic READY at 10:34:29 UTC. Claude/Codex recovery rows remain READY since 07:46 UTC; no evidence establishes a simultaneous three-agent recovery. Pi has four WARM slots and four direct child node processes. Probe timeout cause and reported simultaneous Recovering remain unproven. See recovering-20261017-1055.md.

Generation 70 Pi has four warm STARTING slots with FAILED/NONE sessions, terminal dispatch refusals (CONFLICT, possible_effect=false) and no Core receipts. Pool settlement recognizes CLOSED lease or failed Core receipt but misses pre-Core refusal. Pi UI response used fifth on-demand slot. Require exact durable no-send proof, never infer safe release from FAILED/NONE alone. Exact message matched dispatch inventory freshness refusal. M3g recognizes the terminal pre-Core refusal with no lease, stream, receipt or publication; 18 installed tests passed. Globally deployed in generation 71; old slots were reclaimed, four new warm sessions became available, a real UI call used one and its replacement restored 4/5 availability.

Generation 71 agents reached READY within about 8s, but first new warm reservations appeared about 4m46s after recovery began. Inventory worker observed in fingerprint/discovery; full interval also includes publication/backoff and is not wholly attributed to hashing. Need per-harness effective readiness and lower-cost initial discovery; do not relax inventory freshness or ownership checks. Four warm sessions and real Pi UI response eventually succeeded automatically. M3h parallel passive discovery measured 10.74-13.94s versus 21.75-21.94s serial with identical evidence. Startup readiness no longer inflates warm failure backoff (L15). Installed tests passed; global rollout and independent per-harness publication/readiness remain pending. M3h rolled out with M3j in generation 72. First UI Pi call waited 127.439s to RUNNING and completed in 137.667s; next warm call ran after 0.569s and completed in 7.060s. Initial observation/readiness latency remains unresolved. M3i independent producers globally deployed in generation 73. Pi READY 07:46:24 UTC; four warm opens admitted within 141 ms at 07:46:32. First real UI request at 07:47:00 reached RUNNING after 0.6952s, completed after 10.2113s, and pool replenished automatically. Single functional sample, not full initial-readiness/load qualification.

Pool attempted four speculative starts before current inventory existed and counted admission refusals as warm failures; two rounds can grow backoff to 256s without native startup. Reproduced before fix. Await current host/agent/inventory prerequisites before warm reservation; nine all-harness regression cases and the 46-case installed campaign passed. Actual startup interval attribution remains incomplete; global rollout pending. M3h deployed with M3j generation 72; four warm sessions restored automatically. Historical ended warm sessions still count as actual failures; no manual backoff edit.

Original writer holder and first error are not conclusively attributed; sanitized first-error logging added. General owner replacement remains L10.

This is an M3 resource-isolation requirement, not a proven attribution of the simultaneous Recovering report. Do not relax authority or native-release proofs.
